description: Submission of the International Telecommunications Operators Levy (Imposition) Regulations, No.1 of 2020, to Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - With the imposition of the Regulations published through the Government Gazette in terms of section 22(1) of the Finance Act, No.11 of 2004, the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development is vested with the power to prescribe the rate of International Telecommunications Operators Levy. Accordingly, the International Telecommunications Operators Levy (Imposition) Regulation No.1 of 2010 published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.1662/1 dated 2010‑07-12, which was last amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No. 2312/80 dated 2023‑01-01, has been further amended by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification 2430/14 dated 2025‑04-01. The proposal made by the Hon. President, in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to submit the said amended Regulation to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
